summary: Organization repository inventory, the declared fabric roster, contract ownership and skill applicability describe different populations. registry/repos.yml declares participation capabilities and also includes the owner-qualified external repository EHotwagner/S.I.R. as a non-participant with no org-fabric capabilities; an FS-GG organization listing cannot establish that external repository’s current state. FsQuint is an independent public generic package owner explicitly outside the fabric, and specairn is a future monorepo reservation whose implementation waits for v2 completion. Being outside the fabric does not erase an existing owner or turn every skill or issue-intake obligation off. The architecture’s selected component map must not be treated as an exhaustive current organization census. Verify native inventory and the relevant owner-qualified source when an action depends on current membership; this record does not audit S.I.R. implementation or grant repository authority.
title: Organization inventory, fabric participation and external ownership
